Label: membrane
Basis: Derives entirely from the three ECO:0000255 TM predictions. Those predictions are not reproduced in any ortholog (0/8) and are a 1.9% outlier in PF08578; the segments are more buried than real TM helices and have unfavourable insertion energies. Conflicts with PomBase's own ND annotation on the same gene.

Label: integral component of membrane
Basis: Same provenance as GO:0016020. No evidence for multi-pass topology survives the ortholog test. If any association is retained it should not be an integral-membrane term.

Label: cellular_component
